replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. My experience with math was mostly hands-on, not abstract. I’ve used it for practical tasks like measuring or calculating, so it feels familiar and manageable. Anxiety rarely comes up because I’ve applied it in real life without stress.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: As a retired man, I haven’t used AI for math learning recently. I prefer books and practical examples over digital tools. I’ve always relied on my own understanding and experience, which works well for me without needing new technology.

This method is straightforward for most cases.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture the most variance. First, standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix and its eigenvectors. The eigenvectors give the directions, and their eigenvalues show variance. It’s not too complex—it’s about simplifying data without losing key patterns. No need to panic; it’s more about patterns than advanced math.
